2607.11632.title: Reproducing human biases in route choice using large language models: Toward scalable behavioral modeling
2607.11632.paper_summary: Human choice behavior, including route choice, exhibits systematic behavioral biases that deviate from the assumptions of full rationality. Cumulative prospect theory (CPT) has been widely recognized as an effective framework for characterizing such behavioral patterns. However, its large-scale application, particularly in simulation and agent-based modeling, critically depends on specifying individual-level CPT parameters, which remain a major bottleneck. Conventional approaches typically rely on surveys and controlled experiments to calibrate CPT parameters, yet these methods are difficult to generalize and often fail to capture the full diversity of human decision-making. To address this challenge, this paper investigates whether large language models (LLMs) can reproduce human behavioral biases in choice-making without explicit specification of prospect-theoretic parameters. Using route choice as a representative scenario, we design a behavioral evaluation framework and systematically compare LLM-generated decisions with established human behavioral patterns predicted by CPT. Experimental results demonstrate that LLMs are capable of reproducing non-rational human choice biases and can exhibit decision behaviors consistent with prospect-theoretic effects under uncertainty. These findings suggest that generative AI models may provide a scalable alternative for modeling human decision processes and offer a promising foundation for next-generation large-scale agent-based simulation and AI-driven behavioral research.
2607.11632.paper_summary_zh: 人類的選擇行為，包括路徑選擇，顯示出系統性的行為偏差，這些偏差偏離了完全理性的假設。累積前景理論（CPT）已被廣泛認可為描述這些行為模式的有效框架。然而，其大規模應用，特別是在模擬和基於代理的建模中，關鍵在於指定個體層級的CPT參數，而這仍然是一個主要的瓶頸。傳統的方法通常依賴調查和控制實驗來校準CPT參數，但這些方法難以概括，並且常常無法捕捉人類決策的全部多樣性。為了應對這一挑戰，本文探討大型語言模型（LLMs）是否能在不明確指定前景理論參數的情況下重現人類在選擇中的行為偏差。以路徑選擇作為代表場景，我們設計了一個行為評估框架，並系統性地將LLM生成的決策與CPT預測的已建立人類行為模式進行比較。實驗結果表明，LLMs能夠重現非理性的選擇偏差，並且在不確定性下能夠表現出與前景理論效應一致的決策行為。這些發現表明，生成式AI模型可能為建模人類決策過程提供一種可擴展的替代方案，並為下一代大規模基於代理的模擬和AI驅動的行為研究提供了一個有前景的基礎。
